acceptanceCriteria.text: A failed or expired Kanban attempt displays accessible Retry; activation uses authorized desktop Play and retains history.
A new card shows Play; active, review and done cards show no Retry; renderer regressions and delivery gate pass.
Running app version and observed missing-control versus unclear-label failure are recorded with visual evidence.

body:
## Report
After DM-689 failed, the person could not find a Retry button. Source src/renderer/src/kanban/KanbanCardPanel.tsx:77-82 allows Play for In-progress without an open attempt, but CardBody:273-276 labels the action Play. Installed app 0.45.0, checkout 0.46.0: first determine missing versus unclear control on actual runtime. Never bypass desktop Play authorization or modify records directly.

## Scope
Use an explicit Retry label/action for failed or expired In-progress attempts, invoking the existing authorized Play flow and retaining attempt history. Preserve Play for a new card and hide Retry for active, Ready-for-review and Done cards.

## Source locations
KanbanCardPanel.tsx canPlay/CardBody; KanbanCardPanel.test.tsx Play tests; src/core/services/kanban/attempts.test.ts:594-610 failed-claim lifecycle.

## Tests
Write failing renderer tests for failed-card Retry visibility and ordinary Play invocation; guard active/review/done. Inspect running app and run isolated-card gate.
title: Expose an explicit Retry action for failed Kanban attempts
